author: BmB
body:
Ok so recently i have been punished for caps quite a lot, many of the times i haven't recieved a verbal warning before hand, but that isn't what i want to talk about today. Every time i recieve a caps infraction i always question the staff member who gave me the infraction in a hope i get a sane answer. Almost all of my "caps" infractions are a result of the newer staff members and it really pisses me off how i have come back and been warned or kicked for the slightest thing so that these new mods can look like they are doing their job when the punishments and activity is checked. But going back to the answer of the staff as to why i got my infraction i am always confronted with it's spam or read the rules.

I know this but i don't understand why caps are spam. They don't take up anymore chat space than a regular message which is really the definition of spam. Caps are often used as a way to show feelings better used to highlight a certain point and often just a simple accidental caps lock tap. 

So i am looking for anyone, preferably staff, to explain why CAPS is punishable.

title: Caps - Why?

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
It's not necessarily the caps that will get players in trouble. It's how they use those caps that will get them in trouble.

Don't be vulgar, don't use it excessively and don't use it in a negative way.
Just like any other chat-related offense.

replies.author: BmB
replies.body:
Is there no one here that can see that there have been no valid reasons for a CAPS infraction? 

"Caps are insulting" E.G: YOU ARE FUCKING STUPID: Well that's an infraction for rudeness not caps. 

"Caps are spammy" E.G: HEY-LOL-DEFEND-DEFEND-DIAMONDS PLEASE: That is spam not caps. 

There is absolutely no reason why you should ever receive punishment for caps alone. There are no rules broken it is just something staff have got into the habit of doing and it's a bad habit. 

QUIT IT!
